company.name: Osavul
company.summary: Osavul是一家AI驱动的混合风险情报公司，其平台通过开放和特权数据识别敌对意图，并将威胁映射到客户的人员、设施和供应链上，以在攻击发生前进行预警。公司最初为应对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰而创立，现服务于北约及多国政府和国防机构，并正在向企业和关键基础设施运营商拓展。

products.name: Osavul AI Platform
products.description: AI驱动的混合风险情报平台，利用开放和特权数据识别谁在针对客户，并将敌对意图映射到客户的人员、设施和供应链上，以在攻击发生前进行预警。评估结果可追溯证据、经分析师审核，并可在主权基础设施内本地部署。
products.target_customers: 政府、国防和安全机构、关键基础设施运营商、企业（国防工业、能源、交通、金融服务）
features: 跨信息、网络和物理域识别敌对意图
证据可追溯、分析师审核的评估
可在主权基础设施内本地部署
基于多年与国防和安全机构共同归因敌对行动的知识积累

evidence_refs.quote: Osavul’s AI platform draws on open and privileged data and refines it through a proprietary process built on knowledge its customers do not hold and competitors cannot replicate: years of attributing live hostile campaigns alongside defence and security institutions.
Its AI platform draws on open and privileged data to identify who is targeting a customer, then maps that intent against the customer's people, facilities, and supply chains to anticipate attacks.
Total contract value grew fourfold in 2025
Osavul now serves government, defence and security institutions in more than 10 countries, including the UK, Germany, Poland, the Nordics, the US and APAC

quotes.quote: We built Osavul under live operational conditions, and that experience travels. From Luxembourg we now serve customers worldwide, increasingly in regions facing conflict and instability, where the need for sovereign, multi-language intelligence is most acute.

investment_rationale.speaker: Carlos Alberto Silva
investment_rationale.rationale: 33N Ventures认为对手同时在信息、网络和物理渠道行动，而大多数安全工具仍然孤立；Osavul将三者连接起来，其AI已在全球最严苛和信任敏感的环境中验证，并拥有与北约和国防机构的合作记录，因此支持这些二次创业者打造混合风险情报领域的定义性公司。
investment_rationale.quote: Adversaries operate across information, cyber and physical channels at once; most security tools are still siloed. Osavul connects all three, with AI proven in the world’s harshest and most trust-sensitive environments and a track record with NATO and national defence. We are backing these second-time founders to build the defining company in hybrid risk intelligence – from Europe, for the world.

investment_rationale.speaker: Gabriele Poteliunaite
investment_rationale.rationale: Balnord认为国家无法防御所有目标，欧洲基础设施运营公司正承担从未装备应对的风险；Osavul已在国防部门和安全机构内验证四年，现在将同一能力转向商业运营商，且创始团队此前已共同创建并退出过一家公司。
investment_rationale.quote: The state cannot defend every target, so the companies running Europe's infrastructure are now carrying risk they were never equipped for. Osavul spent four years proving this inside defence ministries and security institutions, and is now turning the same capability toward commercial operators. It's built by a founding team who had already built and exited a company together before starting this one, and we're extremely excited to be onboard.

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是：在敌对混合威胁从政府层面向关键基础设施和商业运营商扩散的背景下，Osavul能否将已在北约和国防机构中验证的跨域情报能力转化为企业级可扩展产品。已验证信号包括：2025年总合同价值增长四倍、服务超过10个国家的政府和国防机构、是仅有的三家交付北约信息环境评估能力的公司之一。证据边界在于：来源未披露具体收入、客户数量或企业端合同金额，企业市场拓展仍处于早期阶段。
validated_signals: 服务超过10个国家的政府、国防和安全机构
是仅有的三家交付北约信息环境评估能力的公司之一
在国防和安全机构中经过四年实战验证
risks: 企业端商业化仍处于早期，来源未披露具体企业客户数量或合同金额，从政府向商业运营商的转化存在不确定性
混合风险情报市场竞争加剧，来源未提供与竞品的直接比较数据，差异化优势的持续性有待验证
